about: Reading plans (scripts/build_more.py). advent: one passage a day from 1 to 24 December, in this order, read with what Logia holds on it; each is a span of verses in the Open Word Bible's numbering. books: a book read whole in so many days, its chapters shared out so each day has about the same number of verses. The plans choose passages only; their words are in i18n/<lang>.json under plans.
